text:
incident-bot: 🔔 Severity P2 - elevated error rate on /generate (prefix KV cache) affecting ~3% requests in eu-west-1. Alerting oncall. https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2759

maria (oncall): I'm on it, paging @aj to join - suspect prefix cache coherency issues after the 03:10 deploy.

aj: joining. seeing a spike of 5xx with `kv-miss` in the logs, but also some timeouts to the prefetch service. sharing logs in #eng-runtime.

samir: quick question — do we have recent rollout changes to prefix caching rules or tenant routing?

maria (oncall): Yes, can confirm a canary for prefix prefetch landed at 03:07 that touched the eviction window. Rolling back would be slow. Prefer surgical mitigations first.

leo: propose immediate mitigations: 1) disable prefetch for eu-west-1 2) apply per-tenant rate cap for top noisy tenants 3) enable prefix-level bypass for requests hitting correctness checks.

aj: +1. How do we toggle prefetch safely?

ops-bot: Command executed: `infra toggle prefetch --region eu-west-1 --state off` — rolled out to 4/4 clusters, 30s ago.

maria (oncall): Prefetch disabled. Latency dropping in canary, error rate still ~2.4% overall.

samir: I'm applying a temporary token quota cut to the largest tenants that spiked — `quota adjust --tenant tenant-42 --rate 0.6x --reason "mitigation"` and similar for 3 others.

aj: Also added a routing rule to redirect 15% of low-priority traffic to the low-cost model variant to reduce KV pressure: `routing set traffic-split /generate 0.15 -> model-x-small`

leo: For correctness cases where prefix lookup fails, we should bypass KV cache and force consistent read path: `config set prefix_kv.fallback=bypass-for-correctness --ttl 10m` — doing a controlled rollout to 1 zone now.

ops-bot: Fallback config applied to eu-west-1a. Monitoring traces for mismatched outputs.

maria (oncall): After these steps: error rate down to 0.8%, tail latency improving. No customer-facing incidents yet but a few API 429s observed from quota cuts.

customer-success: Notifying the two customers with repeated 429s and offering status note + ETA for knob rebalancing. Template drafted.

aj: Leaving a sticky note in the incident doc: require a postmortem action to validate prefetch eviction heuristics and add automated canary rollback if error-rate > 1%.

samir: Agree. Also recommend an automated safe-mode which disables prefetch per-region if KV error-rate delta > 2x baseline.

maria (oncall): Will handoff to @leo for night coverage and monitoring for the next 6 hours. Oncall Handoff: summary + actions taken in the incident doc. If error rate rises above 1% again, escalate to P1.

ops-bot: Handoff recorded: new owner leo, incident status: mitigated (monitoring).

leo: Thanks — I'll watch dashboards. Closing the live mitigation thread; saving commands and config diffs to the incident runbook. :white_check_mark:
